title: 3.5.25 Lab: Objects Capstone — Build, Read, Destructure
description: Build an array of records, read fields with dots and brackets, and destructure a record into variables. Auto-graded.

steps.title: Build an array of records
steps.instructions: Create one array called cart whose elements are objects. Give each object the same fields, for example a name, a price and a quantity. Include at least three records.

steps.title: Add a nested object and a spaced key
steps.instructions: Give one record a nested object as a field, and give one record a key that contains a space, written in quotes.

steps.title: Read fields two ways
steps.instructions: Print a field with a dot, and print the spaced key with square brackets. Also read the nested field with a chain (a dot then another dot).

steps.title: Loop and total
steps.instructions: Loop over the array and print each record's name and its cost (price times quantity), reading each field off the record with a dot.

steps.title: Destructure one record
steps.instructions: Destructure two or more fields out of one of the records into variables, in one statement, and use the bare names in a printed sentence.

steps.title: Walk the keys
steps.instructions: Use Object.keys with a loop to print every key and value of one record, fetching each value with brackets.

requirements.title: loop present
requirements.description: Contains a for loop. Help: 3.3.5 (Looping Over Arrays (for / for…of))

requirements.description: Unpacks with a brace pattern. Help: 3.5.19 (Destructuring)

requirements.title: Object.keys used
requirements.description: Walks the object's keys. Help: 3.5.2 (Grouping Related Values)

requirements.title: cart holds three or more records, one with a nested object and one with a spaced key
requirements.description: cart is an array of at least three objects, one record holds a nested object, one record has a key containing a space, and the program prints at least eight lines. Help: 3.5.23 (Example: Record Shape)
requirements.hint: Build cart with three or more objects. Give one a nested object as a field and one a quoted key with a space in it, then print what the steps ask for.

checks.expr: Array.isArray(cart) && cart.length >= 3 && cart.every(r => r && typeof r === 'object' && !Array.isArray(r)) && cart.some(r => Object.values(r).some(v => v && typeof v === 'object' && !Array.isArray(v))) && cart.some(r => Object.keys(r).some(k => k.includes(' '))) && output.length >= 8
checks.fail: cart should be an array of at least three records, one with a nested object field and one with a key that contains a space, and the program should print at least eight lines.
